concerns: Listing comes from the site's own JSON search API (POST /umbraco/api/searchapi/search, the call the Vue page makes), executed from inside the loaded listing page with page.evaluate, so cookies/challenge state are the visitor's. API answered TotalItemCount 15, one page of 50. 14 shells = 15 minus 1 dropped. Shell counts normal and forced-fallback both 14. If the API call fails the extractor returns no shells (never a DOM guess); robots_gate.allowed() is checked for the API URL (ese robots.txt only blocks SemrushBot).

Relevance (Level 2): the ESE 'Patient Forums' content type (ESE Adrenal Patient Forum 2026) is for patients and is dropped and logged; awareness days / deadlines / key dates would be dropped too (none returned by the default query). Clinician courses, webinars (ESE Talks, Clinical Updates), congresses and External/Endorsed meetings are kept.

Fees: Porto PG course has a two-header-row grid (category row + 'Before/After Early Bird deadline' row) that the generic pricing_tables parser mangled (8 tiers, wrong labels, dropped columns), so ese_hormones.py has a bespoke parse_fee_grid (12 tiers verified against the page). Other events: no fee on the page; 'External Events' link to organiser sites (organiser_url from Register/Website links) - Harvard 'Clinical Endocrinology 2027' (learn.hms.harvard.edu) was fetch_failed in a scratch discover() run (httpx blocked), TALENT registers via endo.deskonline.info; ECE 2027 is a save-the-date with no fees yet. Member-only prices are not an issue (rates are public); 'Ukraine free' concession not modelled.

Coverage warnings explained: SINGLE_DAY_SUSPECT (2 rows, evidence '8-11 May 2027') is the ECE 2027 promo banner in the site chrome, not the event's own text; SUBMISSION_NO_DEADLINE on TALENT: the page names Young Investigator Spotlights/awards but gives no deadline; PRICE_EXTERNAL_LINK on TALENT and Harvard as above.
ESE 'ECE 2027' is a Save-the-date page without venue name or fees; the congress is also available as its own site later (not linked yet).

HQ LESSON #95: regexes accept single or double quotes (WFNS raw HTML uses single quotes, the rendered DOM double); extract_detail reads page.content() (the rendered DOM the pipeline sees) and only falls back to fetch_html when the page lacks the markup.
Terms/robots: footer links Privacy, Cookies, Accessibility, Disclaimer; the Disclaimer page (read in full) has no clause on automated access, scraping or AI use. robots.txt blocks only SemrushBot.

Taxonomy ask: society code 'ESE' (European Society of Endocrinology, international, Europe) in societies.ts; note existing 'Endocrine Society' (US) is a different body. Specialty from the shared title classifier with default 'Diabetes & Endocrinology'.
Requests to ese-hormones.org over development + both harness runs: about 40 including API calls, sequential.
